notes: Installed globally via npm install -g mobile-security-mcp
Provides apk_identify, rasp_identify, apk_scan_secrets, android_api_extractor, frida_spawn, search_strings

recommended_sequence: rasp_identify <apk>         -> detect enterprise RASP (Zimperium, DexGuard, Promon, Arxan)
frida_spawn <pkg>           -> spawn target with instrumentation hooks
